signal.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
signal.summary: Google announced the global integration of Gemini 4 Hydrogen into Search on November 12, 2026, aiming to interpret complex, multi-part queries and present more visual, structured results with links to relevant sources. A separate model launch establishes Hydrogen's developer positioning and published pricing. SXF separates the consumer Search experience from paid API access, examines what the launch can and cannot establish about traffic referrals, and offers a verifiable query-testing checklist for publishers.

signal.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
signal.summary: The ggml-org team announced version 1.0.0 of the llama.cpp and ggml libraries on November 13, 2026, clarifying semantic-versioning contracts for public C interfaces. Future API or ABI-breaking changes trigger major-version increments, while compatible features and bug fixes use minor and patch increments. The milestone matters to application integrators and package maintainers; it is not a claim that all backends have identical behaviour or that throughput improved by a measured percentage.

signal.title: Strengthening NATO and allied cyber defenses with AI
signal.summary: On November 17, 2026, OpenAI described its cyber defense work with NATO's Communications and Information Agency and allied public agencies, including authorized uses of Daybreak to investigate vulnerabilities, validate findings and prepare fixes. OpenAI reports NATO usage reaching up to 300 billion raw input and output tokens per month, and cites a Crossed Swords 2026 exercise organized by the NATO CCDCOE. SXF explains how to distinguish provider-reported operational activity, human-confirmed vulnerabilities and real security outcomes instead of assuming token volume is a defense effectiveness metric.

signal.title: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on November 16, 2026
signal.summary: GitHub deprecated Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra across most Copilot experiences on November 16, 2026. GitHub lists Claude Opus 5.5 for the first two and GPT-6.1 Sol or GPT-6 Luna for Terra, with specific exceptions for annual individual subscriptions and a runtime refusal fallback. SXF distinguishes removal from model pickers from legacy availability, and supplies a migration and permission-audit checklist for business and enterprise administrators.

signal.title: Manage AI Scan for repositories using the REST API
signal.summary: GitHub announced on November 13, 2026 a public-preview REST setting called repository_scan to manage AI Scan for repositories at organization and repository level. The update allows settings automation via GET and PATCH APIs but does not automatically run a scan; users with repository write access start scans on demand, consuming GitHub Code Security AI credits. SXF explains inheritance, enterprise policy, conflict errors and rollout checks, differentiating configuration from scanning results.
